title: Add 'subclass' RulesRecordKind + kindSchema
description:
Per ADR 0009, add a first-class `subclass` record kind (Champion, Life domain, School of Evocation, ...). Base classes stay `class`; subclasses are their own addressable kind so the DM can lookup_rules them by name.

Scope:
- Add 'subclass' to RulesRecordKind union in packages/core/src/rules/types.ts.
- Add a BASE_KIND_VALIDATORS entry + validateDnd5eSubclass in packages/core/src/rules/kindSchemas.ts. A subclass links to its parent base class via data.parentClass (parent class record key). Validate ONLY fields a subclass carries (parentClass, description, granted-feature references) — NOT the base-class scalar fields (hitDie/proficiencies).
- Extend lookup_rules enum in packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolLookupRules.ts (two enum sites).

Linkage is data-side only (data.parentClass); do NOT use 'overrides' (that is the pack-layering replacement mechanism in stack.ts). Infrastructure only — the subclass parser is a separate bead.
acceptance_criteria:
- 'subclass' is a member of RulesRecordKind and validated by BASE_KIND_VALIDATORS.
- validateDnd5eSubclass enforces data.parentClass + description; does NOT require base-class fields.
- lookup_rules accepts kind='subclass' in both enum sites.
- Typecheck + tests pass.
- ADR 0009 referenced in code comments.
close_reason: Added subclass RulesRecordKind + kindSchema (validateDnd5eSubclass), validate.ts + lookup_rules enums, tests
